decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet still fits the firm's broad interior concepts and accessories business, and with one similar carpet already removed the remaining assortment looks more defensible.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet supports the firm's premium craftsmanship and material-quality positioning, so management would usually retain it despite its narrower audience.
Because it overlaps strongly with other low-pile carpets and the firm has already shown willingness to streamline this sub-range, this is the most likely candidate to be withdrawn to free resources.
A corner bench extends naturally into residential, hospitality and project interiors, which suits the firm's core furniture offer and argues for continued market presence.
The swivel shell chair line aligns closely with flexible workplace and public-interior demand and is therefore unlikely to be discontinued after only a relatively short time on the market.
